checks.title: How we get and check the data
checks.lead: Four steps before a number reaches you.
checks.collectBody: From government portals and other reputed sources — some automatically, some by hand.
checks.checkBody: Empty, zero or impossible values are left out — never filled in with a guess.
checks.compareBody: Where a second source exists, we compare the two. Doubtful updates from the news wait for a person to review them.
checks.showBody: Every number says where it came from and when. Old data is marked as old.
checks.link: See it for yourself: check {name}'s data
